windows.command: python -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: Watch progress log (full runs)

windows.command: if (!(Test-Path results\progress.log)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Force results\progress.log | Out-Null }; Get-Content results\progress.log -Wait -Tail 40

tasks.command: mkdir -p results && touch results/progress.log && tail -n 40 -f results/progress.log

tasks.label: Watch progress log (quick check)

windows.command: if (!(Test-Path results_quick\progress.log)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Force results_quick\progress.log | Out-Null }; Get-Content results_quick\progress.log -Wait -Tail 40

tasks.command: mkdir -p results_quick && touch results_quick/progress.log && tail -n 40 -f results_quick/progress.log
